subject: ArgonPay — deployment route & hosted quickstart questions
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@argonpay.com>, Tom Wu <tom.wu@argonpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: ArgonPay — deployment route & hosted quickstart questions

Hi Elena / Tom,

Thanks again for taking the demo today — great conversation. Quick recap & proposed next steps so we can align on an evaluation that matches your risk and throughput needs.

Recap (what we covered)
- ArgonPay use case: real-time payouts and risk-scoring prompts (short text generation + embeddings for search).
- Typical per-request token mix: ~120 tokens input, ~40 tokens generation; expected bursty peaks during settlement windows.
- Requirements callout: PCI-adjacent data, 99.9% availability target, prefer not to bring hardware for the initial proof.

Deployment pathway options (narrowing):
1) Hosted API (recommended pilot) — fastest start, sandbox endpoints, per-token billing. Good for evaluation & can scale to production with Reserved/Dedicated later.
2) Dedicated capacity — when you need predictable throughput and dedicated GPU pools (we discussed >200 RPS sustained during batch windows).
3) Private (VPC / on-prem) — required for full on-prem or strict network isolation; longer lead time and procurement.

Please confirm if the pilot should be a Hosted API sandbox (we can enable a private sandbox with VPC egress controls) or you want to scope Dedicated from the outset. My recommendation for ArgonPay: Hosted pilot to validate latency and prompt sets, then a move to Dedicated if you need a committed baseline during production settlement periods.

Next steps I can action this week:
- Share a tailored quickstart checklist and sandbox endpoint details (attached).
- Provide a rate-cap proposal for sandbox + production targets; we need your expected concurrent requests and peak RPS.
- If you want, Marissa can jump in with a short technical preflight (network egress, KMS requirements).

Requested from ArgonPay before the kickoff:
- Typical daily requests and 95/99th latency targets (ballpark is fine).
- Any firm requirement for private deployment at pilot start (yes/no).

I'll follow up with the checklist and a short rate-cap worksheet — aim to get the sandbox ready by Monday if we have numbers.

Thanks,

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0129

Attachments: ArgonPay_quickstart_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-quickstart-playbook.pdf (doc)

From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@argonpay.com>

Cc: Tom Wu <tom.wu@argonpay.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 18:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ArgonPay — deployment route & hosted quickstart questions

Jordan,

Thanks for the recap and the clear options — that matches our takeaways. A few specifics from our side to help size the pilot:
- Expected pilot volume: ~150k requests/day (mostly during 10AM–2PM PT settlement window).
- Peak concurrency: rough peaks of ~120 RPS during a 10–15 minute stretch.
- Latency goal: 95th < 300ms for text-gen calls; embeddings can be higher (95th < 800ms).
- Data sensitivity: payloads include masked PANs and transaction metadata; we'd prefer not to do on-prem for the pilot but will need strong audit/logging and bring-your-own-key (KMS) options.

Two asks:
1) Can you call out sandbox rate limits and token quotas for the Hosted evaluation?
2) Any quick guidance on what reserve level (Dedicated) typically maps to 120 RPS sustained?

If you can send the sandbox details and the rate-cap worksheet, we can review with security and prep a short preflight call.

Cheers,
Elena
Head of Integrations | ArgonPay
elena.martinez@argonpay.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@argonpay.com>, Tom Wu <tom.wu@argonpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ArgonPay — deployment route & hosted quickstart questions

Elena — thanks, that's very helpful. Short answers below and an ask for one small number so we can produce a draft rate-cap plan.

Sandbox / Hosted evaluation details (summary) - Sandbox endpoints: we will provision a private sandbox project for ArgonPay with a non-public base URL; it mirrors our hosted runtime (same kernel selection & batching behavior).
- Sandbox default quotas: 60 RPS / 600k tokens/day. We can adjust for the pilot with a temporary increase (subject to pricing guardrails).
- Token accounting: input + output tokens counted. Estimated bill for pilot depends on your token volume; I'll attach a worked example.
- Security controls: KMS integration (BYOK) and audit logs available in the Hosted plan; we can enable restricted egress and IP allowlists for the sandbox.

Dedicated sizing guidance - For ~120 RPS sustained (120 requests * avg 160 tokens/request = ~19.2k tokens/sec at peak), teams typically reserve a small Dedicated pool (2-4 GPUs depending on model family and quantization). We'll provide a modeled estimate after you confirm which model family you want to evaluate (we recommend a 13B quantized variant for cost/latency trade-offs).

Quick ask: can you confirm whether 120 RPS peak is with synchronous single-call requests or will you be using streaming/async where you might pipeline? That affects batching and the sizing calculation.

Planned next items from our side:
- Marissa will send a short network/KMS preflight checklist and the rate-cap worksheet (one-sheet) — aim within 2 business days.
- I'll prepare a sandbox quota bump request to support the 120 RPS peak for your pilot window (requires an internal approval).

Marissa, Ben — looping you in for the technical notes (network egress, KMS config, typical Dedicated sizing).

Best,
Jordan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@argonpay.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 10:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ArgonPay — deployment route & hosted quickstart questions

Elena / team — quick technical preflight items to speed the pilot: please confirm the following so we can provision correctly.

1) Network & egress - Do you need a VPC egress NAT for sandbox traffic or is IP allowlisting sufficient? If you want VPC peering we can discuss the Private deployment, but for Hosted sandbox many customers choose IP allowlist + restricted egress.

2) KMS / keys - Do you require BYOK? If so, what provider (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault)? We can accept encrypted model inputs and will map keys to your sandbox project.

3) Model family & prompt pattern - Which Redwood model family to test (we recommended 13B quantized). Also, if you have a short canonical prompt set (5–10 examples) please share — we will run baseline latency & quality tests.

4) Traffic shape - Is the 120 RPS an instantaneous burst or averaged over the 10–15 minute settlement window? If instantaneous bursts hit 200–250 RPS for 1–2 minutes we need to plan for transient quotas / burst capacity.

Action items I will take once you reply:
- Provision private sandbox project + generate credentials.
- Create a rate-cap worksheet that models sandbox + production cost and impact of caching (prefix/KV).
- Schedule 30-min technical preflight with you and Ben for early next week.

Thanks — happy to take this to the preflight call and walk through the items.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
